report_title: Recovery Safety & Blast Radius Isolation Report

safety_checks.mitigation_details: Max retry limit capped at 3 attempts within 5-minute rolling window before escalating to operator.
Initial backoff 1s, factor 2.0 with ±20% randomized jitter; max backoff 30s.
AI provider failure degrades extraction mode gracefully; API Gateway and core DB remain 100% operational.
Hard timeout of 45 seconds enforced via asyncio.wait_for; cancels hanging child processes on expiry.
Minimum 60-second cooldown enforced between automated recovery executions.
